queries_run: Eaton market share gaining data center electrical competitors Schneider Vertiv 2026
Eaton new entrant OR displace threat electrical equipment data center 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 自述 Eaton 在電氣類與航太類分部競爭地位強、多數產品屬市場領導者之列；競爭要素為效能、技術、服務與價格。
findings.excerpt: Eaton has a strong competitive position in these segments and, with respect to many products, is considered among the market leaders.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子承認新進入者可能衝擊其產品或區域市場地位；漲價等因應措施也可能損及市占。未點名具體新進入者。
findings.excerpt: Our positions may also be impacted by new entrants into our product or regional markets.

findings.claim: 搜尋未找到具名新進入者或替代供應商搶單的來源；MarketsandMarkets 稱 Schneider、ABB、Eaton、Vertiv、Delta 合計約占資料中心電源市場 41–43%，無 Eaton 單獨份額與消長方向。
findings.source: MarketsandMarkets Top Data Center Power Companies

competitive_share_entrants.note: 無第三方份額消長數據；Eaton 2026Q2 資料中心有機營收 +65% 對市場 +23% 之說僅見於低可信度轉述（rallies.ai），未列入 finding。

clues.claim: Eaton 2026Q2 資料中心有機營收成長約 65%，高於市場成長約 23%（轉述來源）。
